sources.quote: Sigma Aquilae, also named Hru, is an eclipsing binary star system in the equatorial constellation of Aquila.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 6.1 solar radii and 6.25 solar masses (FLAME) and 16,195 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
